name_reason: Follows data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=chapter ending, descriptor=credit_roll_scripted_outcome_table. Reflects the data type (table/array). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Accurately describes the role: per-duel scripted-cinematic mode/terrain index for the 20 staff-roll duels.
purpose: Const 20-byte table giving the scripted-cinematic mode/terrain index for each of the 20 staff-roll duels played during the game-clear ending cinematic.
logic_summary: fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (0x2bce5) block-copies all 20 bytes onto its stack via MOVSD x5 (a speed optimization), then in the credit-roll loop (char_idx 0..0x13) reads one byte per iteration (MOVZX, stride 1, no element scaling), stores it into data_fd2_battle_scripted_cinematic_mode_or_terrain_idx (@0x540FF), and calls fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic(0,1) to run that pre-scripted duel. Sibling tables data_fd2_chapter_ending_credit_roll_top_portrait_id_table (0x525DC) and ..._bottom_portrait_id_table (0x525F0) supply the two fighters' portrait ids for the same 20 duels.
element_semantics: Each byte = scripted-cinematic mode/terrain index for one of the 20 ending staff-roll duels (index 0..19). Value is written verbatim into data_fd2_battle_scripted_cinematic_mode_or_terrain_idx before fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic runs the duel. Observed values 0x03..0x35.
notes: Only xrefs are READ+DATA from fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (no writers) -> truly read-only, declared const. Memory at 0x52604 matches the src initializer byte-for-byte (04 03 33 0E 19 12 28 35 16 18 1C 11 1E 1F 32 21 22 34 24 2F). Src comment block (chtab2.c lines 263-280) was already precise and correct -> kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x52604 was empty -> created a concise plate consistent with the src conclusion. The plate's older sibling-function comment described these as '5x1B/5x4B' tables, but that refers only to the MOVSD x5 copy mechanism; actual access is per-byte across all 20 entries, which both src and the new plate state correctly.
